settings.title: Projects
settings.desc: Chat, runs, and logs work only inside registered folders. Changes in this section apply immediately, with no Save button.
settings.appStored: Stored in the app: {chats} chats · {runs} runs
settings.reregisterBlocked: The folder overlaps another project, so it can't be registered again
settings.legacyTitle: There are older records that don't belong to a project
settings.legacyDesc: These records are from before projects existed. They only show inside a project now, so add them to a project to see them again. You can resume them only after adding them.
settings.assignTitle_one: Add {n} older {feature} record to a project
settings.assignTitle_other: Add {n} older {feature} records to a project
settings.assignRecommended: The folder is inside this project
settings.assignNote: After you add them, they show as this project's {feature} records. You can't move them back out of the project.
settings.assignDirect: Save directly in the project folder
settings.cleanupTitle: Project-only items from the old method
settings.cleanupDesc_one: There is {count} item that was made project-only with the old method. It still exists in the shared library even if you don't move it. Moving it to its project makes it that project folder's item, so you can run it there.
settings.cleanupDesc_other: There are {count} items that were made project-only with the old method. They still exist in the shared library even if you don't move them. Moving them to their project makes them that project folder's items, so you can run them there.
settings.cleanupOrphans_one: {count} item can't be moved because its project is gone
settings.cleanupOrphans_other: {count} items can't be moved because their project is gone
settings.cleanupOrphansHelp: Register the project again to move them.
settings.recordsDesc: Chat and run records are stored in the project folder. The ones below are older records stored in this app, not in a folder. They're read-only; if you move them to the folder, other apps that registered the folder can see them too.
settings.recordsMoveBlocked: This folder is read-only, so chat and run records can't be saved
settings.moveTitle: Move older records to the project folder — {name}
settings.moveScope: All app records of this project ({chats} chats · {runs} runs)
settings.moveRemove: Delete from the app after moving
settings.moveRemoveHelp: If off, a copy stays in the app and the same records show in two places
settings.archiveApply: This item applies with [Save] at the top of the page.
settings.archiveShareWarning: The archive copy includes the full conversation text (including tool output). If you sync this folder to the cloud or share it, the original conversations are shared too. The archive folder is excluded from git by default.
settings.archiveNoCredentials: Sign-in information isn't archived. Only the original conversation files are copied.
settings.moveNote1: A conversation moves together with its runs and events.
settings.moveNote2: After moving, the records also show in other apps that registered this folder.
settings.moveNote3: Records that already exist in the folder are skipped.
